A Consistently Outstanding Experience
May 2025 • Friends
For the past three years, every time we visit Miami, a stop at El Matador is non-negotiable — and let me tell you, it never disappoints. You know how sometimes you hype up a place so much and it doesn’t always meet expectations? That has never been the case here. Every visit is as incredible as the last, if not better.

The outdoor seating is stunning, but what truly elevates the experience is the service. From Mayrelys’s attentiveness (she never lets a drop of water go missing from your glass!) to seeing familiar faces like Carlos and Oscar, who’ve taken amazing care of us over the years — the service is consistently top-notch. This time, we had Maria as our server, and she was an absolute sweetheart: attentive, kind, and full of great recommendations.

We also had the pleasure of meeting the new GM, Laetitia. Classy, professional, yet so warm and down to earth. Watching her step in to help clean and support the staff despite her high position was inspiring. Chef Noel is another gem — funny, kind, and the mastermind behind the magic in the kitchen.

A special shout-out to Jean, the bartender. Do not miss the gin and tonic side bar experience he offers. He’ll walk you through unique options like Monkey 47 and Malfi gin paired with a variety of tonic waters. It’s like a vacation in a glass — beautiful and delicious. Also, fun fact: Jean is an incredible opera singer! Ask him to sing something and help him get discovered.

Food highlights:
– Short rib tacos — absolutely to die for.
– Guacamole with peas — a surprising twist that works beautifully.
– Arroz con pollo — served with crispy chicken skin that is next-level delicious.

Drink highlights:
– Tropical Old Fashioned and Negroni Colada — both are must-tries from the indoor bar.

If you’re grabbing drinks inside, Valeria will take great care of you. She’s energetic, personable, and adds to the vibrant vibe of the place.

In short: sit outside, soak in the atmosphere, enjoy the impeccable food and drinks, and let the wonderful staff make your night memorable. El Matador is a gem that keeps shining, year after year.

A Rare Jewel, Exceeded Expectations
May 2023 • Couples
Jean George’s Matador Room is a rare jewel of the Miami Beach restaurant scene that perfectly captures the essence of what fine dining is meant to be. While staying at the beautiful Miami Beach Edition Hotel, we dined at the Matador Room three times and we couldn’t get enough of it. The terrace seating for brunch or lunch delivers a modern tropical garden overlooking the pool that offers sunshine, blue skies and greenery punctuated with pink Bougainville. The main room for dinner combines immersive, warm mood lighting and elegant decor that make you feel like you’ve been whisked away into the grand dining room of an Old World Conquistador. Chef Lateisha, who heralds from the Bronx and is as humble as she is accomplished, hit a five out of five on every single dish, a feat I have never experienced before - having lived in Manhattan previously. From the maitake mushrooms (surprise favorite) and the hearts of palm heirloom tomato salad, to the black truffle and fontina cheese pizza and the glazed short rib tacos, we found ourselves in culinary heaven. Chef Lateisha was gracious enough to spend some time at our table speaking about her passion for the art she has most certainly mastered. Service was refined and outstanding at every level. The waiter’s assistant, Schneider, was a class act. Matthew (our server for brunch) was gregarious, fun and dashing. He made us feel taken care of. And the star of the show was Kara, our server for dinner and lunch. Kara was practically perfect in every way. She was attentive, personable, articulate and warm. She has mastered the art of hospitality and her recommendations were spot on. She is the standard by which we will measure all servers going forward. Overall, our experience was spectacular.
